scope: Exact source/receipt archive and native boards. Frozen generic reporter wording is inherited; current conditional/neural modes are phase-kernel reconstruction above fixed global analytic/neural backgrounds. Raw H1 uses its own original scores. Prior sinusoidal129 has a local competing fit whereas phase129 uses a global competing fit; the paired comparison changes the complete reconstruction, not only waveform capacity.
status: complete; much higher constructed weak response with noise/error and real-artifact costs
quality_decision: Neural phase400/far weak response4.695% to27.390%, both sources gain response, but quiet+2.352% and weak-increment+0.434% versus parent. Analytic phase28.558% with increment-0.539%, but larger real bands. NN building maximum75.18 DN16 versus15.55 prior sinusoidal; analytic531.58 versus302.55. Fine cab crossings remain absent. Preserve as experimental capacity/error tradeoff; no preferred operating point or general model change.
scope_clarification: Fixed global joint-fit background; global competing H1 subtraction; native129 phase average minus local mean. Identical fixed composite operator on RAW and parent innovation. Prior sinusoidal129 has local competing-direction fits, so this is a complete reconstruction comparison, not a waveform-only causal ablation. No neural replay or learned update.
